title: Automatic reminders say members with the app get them, but many app members silently get none
what: The Automatic reminders page says members with the MettleUp app get the plan-end, birthday, welcome and other reminders. The server only gives a member's plan and birthday to their phone when their mobile was proven, is on exactly one member of the list, and their first name in the app matches the list. Two family members on one mobile, a member whose app name is spelt differently, or one who never proved their number get no reminders at all. The page shows only how many switches are on, never how many members they reach or who is left out and why.
expected: The reminders page shows how many members each reminder reaches, and lists the ones it cannot reach with the reason (shared number, name does not match, number not proven, no birthday saved), so the owner can fix them or message them on WhatsApp.
how_often: every day, for each member who shares a mobile or whose app name differs
fix_line: Show on the reminders page who each reminder reaches and why the others are left out

title: Member questions page promises a phone notification for every reply
what: The Member questions page tells the owner and trainers that each reply shows in the member's app with a notification on their phone. The notification only comes when the member's phone allows MettleUp notifications and the phone maker does not hold it back, and it never comes on an iPhone. The page cannot tell which members will see it.
expected: The words say the reply always shows in the member's app, and that a notification comes when their phone allows it.
how_often: every time the page is opened
fix_line: Say the notification comes only when the member's phone allows it

items.reason: cannot be proven in the cloud, needs a real-phone check: automatic reminders and trainer-reply notifications are set and shown by the member's phone (9:30 am, OPPO/Xiaomi/Samsung battery saver, screen off, notifications allowed, iPhone gets none); the panel's own alerts need a desk browser or installed panel on Android with the tab hidden
